args.prompt:
One continuous take, a single unbroken camera move, no cuts. @Image1 is the first frame. The man: enormous waxed handlebar moustache with spiral tips that always covers his mouth, black turtleneck, charcoal blazer. The gold AURUM can keeps its exact label.
[0-1 s] Extreme macro: the ring-pull cracks open with a loud crisp metallic CRACK and a sharp fizzing hiss; cold vapour and droplets burst out.
[1-4 s] The camera pulls back fast and smoothly, rising, revealing that he is standing on a tiny platform at the very top of a skyscraper spire, hundreds of metres above a vast golden city at sunset; strong wind gusts are heard.
[4-8 s] Calm and deadpan, he pours the sparkling pale gold soda from the can into a tall plain clear glass he holds; loud bubbling fizz as it fills; the camera drifts in to a medium shot.
[8-10 s] He lifts the glass under his huge moustache and takes a long drink, the level visibly dropping; we hear a satisfying gulp and a refreshed exhale; one eyebrow rises.
Sound: realistic synchronized sound effects only — can crack, hiss, wind, pour fizz, gulp, exhale. No music, no speech.
